about: The launch view across the harbour as the game draws it beyond its kit: the rocket (the game's kept model earth_launch_rocket, made again on the route with library surfaces), the harbour, the far ground, the rocket's floodlight, the moonlight and the night sky. Frame: EarthSite's own.

objects.name: rocket
objects.from: earth_site.gd:260-262 ROCKET_AT (-270, 0, -60) and ROCKET_HEIGHT, 1282-1285 _stand_the_rocket_up (turned PI / 2); launch_rocket.gd:14-15 TALL 60 m. The rocket is the game's kept model earth_launch_rocket (data/definitions/prop.json; Pixal3D take wf-launch-rocket-2) made again on the route: painted by its close-up's SAM regions with the judge's materials (hull_white_gloss, dark_panel, bare_steel; data/parts/wf-launch-rocket-2.npz) and baked from the library (make_chunky, 60k triangles), past the model gate, kept in the world's release as models/launch_rocket; its foot stands on the top of the stage's pad pieces (1.2 m up; the game's deck lies on the ground). Its baked box is 59.72 m tall, so it is scaled by 1.005 to 60 m.

mirror.from: game/art/shaders/harbour.gdshader:38-47,186-202 (MIRROR_ALONG 0.65, MIRROR_DOWN 0.2 eased by the square root of how far down the eye looks, RIPPLE_TIP 0.03, RIPPLE_SIZE 0.2; the water's own colour is sea.tres water_color, the library's harbour_water)

moon.from: night.gd:16-17 (MOON_HEIGHT_DEGREES 23, MOON_ACROSS_DEGREES 4.4), 180-184 moon_way from the balcony toward the rocket; night_dome.gdshader:12-18,43-68 (MOON_BRIGHTNESS 1.2, SEAS 0.4, its face noise) and night_sky.gdshaderinc:25-26 (HALO 0.35, HALO_FALL 0.09); earth_night_sky.tres moon_color #e6ebf2; lit 1, the full Moon of the game's shots

kit_glow.from: night.gd:38-39,270-291 KIT_GLOW 0.9 on every kind its kit marks night_glow (the launch-kit branch, #130); ink_textured.gdshader:67-68,106-109 GLOW_RAMP 0.15

environment.from: sky.gd:89 NIGHT_AMBIENT 0.05, EARTHSHINE colour, exposure 0.85; night.gd

haze.from: game/prologue/earth_site/night/night.gd:27-29,245-262 (an open ring SHORE_RADIUS 300 - 3 m round the site, 150 m tall from the water, 96 sides), game/art/shaders/night_haze.gdshader:13-30,49-56 (faint 0.15, thickening from 50 m to 0.35 at 84 m, gone by 150 m; 0.97 on the ground up to 24 m in the gap the pictures leave from 302 to 58 degrees, earth_shore_1.tres and _4.tres), night_sky.gdshaderinc:20-30 and earth_night_haze.tres (its colour the night sky's, horizon #03335f deepening to zenith #020c22, worked out here from an eye 1.7 m over the water at the site's middle; the Moon's glow left out)

stars.from: game/world/sky/sky.gd:19-33,517-544 (SEED 9, STAR_COUNT 1800, SKY_DISTANCE 700: a SphereMesh of radius 0.7 with 4 sides and 2 rings, scaled 0.4 to 1.3, every direction), game/art/materials/star.tres (unshaded #eef2ff); hung here at 1900 m with each star as wide seen from the middle, past everything the stage holds and inside the views' 2000 m reach, as the game hangs them just inside its camera's reach; turned with the place's own axes, where the game turns them with the world's spin and the hour, which the record does not carry

game_only: the far city across the harbour is the framework's own, in 3D (the far_city place, tools/usd/far_city_stage.py, seed 7): 2,188 made towers of five kinds rows deep along a far shore 1.3 to 1.8 km off, their windows lit, with code-built mountains behind and water out to the shore; the pencil tower, the low waterfront block and the housing slab are not made yet, so their lots carry the made kinds and the waterfront has no low blocks. The game hangs four photographs of Hong Kong there instead (earth_site.gd:327-335,959-972), which no stage carries
the lit columns the game paints onto the water (each lit thing's streak, harbour.gdshader's lit_columns); the water mirrors what stands round it
the stars' turn: the field is the game's own (its seed, count and sizes), turned with the place's axes, not with the world's spin and the hour
